answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies can be achieved via staked reputation. Agents must deposit significant capital as a 'proof of stake' to gain influence. This stake serves as an economic barrier. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities would find their resources rapidly depleted, reaching an economic nadir. Re-establishing trust from this low point, akin to building an oasis on a barren knoll, would be prohibitively expensive, ensuring genuine participation.
